veranderings.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
veranderings.rede: 'vir 'n tyd' follows English 'for a time'; ''n tyd lank' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form with the same meaning.

veranderings.blok: Nandi se dood en die rou
veranderings.rede: One 'kondig' a period of mourning 'af'; 'beveel' takes a command or a person as object, not a period, so the collocation reads stiffly.

veranderings.blok: Shaka se dood en sy nalatenskap
veranderings.rede: The preceding sentence has the town KwaDukuza as subject, so 'Sy' reaches back two sentences; naming Shaka makes the reference (and the later 'sy leërs') clear.
